prompt: Customers report stale prices: after an admin changes a price, the shop sometimes keeps showing the old one. test/prices.test.ts reproduces support ticket #4412. Find the cause and fix it everywhere it occurs, without turning off caching.

diag.skill: Debugging from a symptom to the root cause, then fixing every occurrence (two cache-invalidation sites, plus an off-by-one expiry).
diag.trap: Fixing only updatePrice (the visible test), missing the bulk import path and the `<` vs `<=` expiry; or disabling the cache to make the symptom go away.
